Version 1.0.1 Changelog

- Overhauled user identity handling: now managed internally by the system; users are never asked for, see, or input any open-id or identity value.
- Simplified workflow and documentation to reflect fully automatic user identity association for both analysis and report queries.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify new identity handling process, removing all instructions and examples related to user-supplied open-id.
- Improved guidance and sample commands for cloud-based report querying (now always internal identity).
- Removed obsolete identity-checking logic and updated/removed scripts as needed; deleted redundant code (e.g., scripts/api_service.py).
- Enhanced resource index, usage guidance, and notices for a more user-friendly and privacy-controlled experience.

- Initial release of the pet UV safety monitor analysis skill.
- Provides real-time camera analysis to detect pets entering active UV-C disinfection areas and UV lamp status.
- Automatically triggers high-risk alerts, recommends shutting off the UV lamp, and logs incidents to prevent pet injury.
- Supports smart home integration and includes strict open-id verification for saving and retrieving reports.
- Allows users to view historical safety reports via standardized API calls, outputting results in structured Markdown tables.
